items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: With Chick, we had like three changes or changes. We would like wear a sport outfit maybe for two shows. Myabe we wear the tuxedos for the supper show.

ctx.x: You mentioned with Chick's band, that you have sometimes four different changes of uniform in one evening?

Yeah. We would have to. With Chick, we had like three changes or changes. We would like wear a sport outfit maybe for two shows. Myabe we wear the tuxedos for the supper show. Then we'd come back with a solid suit for the last show -- the last two shows, or something like that. But with Cab Calloway, we had to change every show. We had to change -- sport outfit, and then we wear a brown coat, you know, (inaudible) and brown pants what we have to wear. We have on maybe a gray and brown, or some pants like that.…

He bought all the clothes. He had to pay for all the uniforms. Had tails, we had tuxedos, we had sport outfits, and a couple of other -- maybe other solid suits, you know.
